notes.title: Jump Tale turns free to play
notes.content: Starting with the 15.03.2024 (3.15.2024) Jump Tale will turn free to play.

notes.title: Late Spring Sale 60% off
notes.content: [b]Jump Tale couldn't go on sale with all the other games because it was released one day too late. Therefor it now has to come on sale one day later. It is on sale with 60%. It will only cost 1€/$ so why not just try it out.[/b]

notes.title: Simple fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a very hard jump in level 3-8
- Made the end of level 2-2 easier
- Changed "Levels" to "Level" in the Menu
